args.body: Deliver the bilingual operator-only terms under the existing CATALOGUE-COMMISSION-TERMS-PROPOSAL mission and valid ownership. Reuse any equivalent terms. Use the verified live offer and completed clean and duplicate-image run to define one fixed-scope deliverable and observable pass conditions. State the exact location granularity the checker returned and label any finer row location as manual. Use CAD 60 only as the existing unvalidated price hypothesis, subject to operator approval. Include the stop condition for out-of-scope input. Save and read back the terms, hash and acceptance crosswalk, then close with a lesson. Leave triage with FULFILLMENT. No external send, order creation, payment instructions, spending or deployment.

description: Prioritize a commission proposal the operator can use when a qualified catalogue buyer arrives. The live offer and completed text-only rehearsal support drafting testable terms. Commercial feedback is available but remains unattributed for five sources, so the absence of classified requests leaves demand unknown. Treasury is unfunded and shows no verified revenue. The existing item 4 outreach pilot can resume on an authorized operator decision or an eligible inbound reply. A paid order requires a real eligible request, approved terms and administrative acceptance. Preserve the welfare checkpoint at 17:00 UTC on November 20 and site retirement at 17:00 UTC on December 4.
